name: agent-dev-workflow
description: Workflows for running real work through AI coding agents: a plan-check-log loop, decision memory with drift checks, generated views that can't invent facts, parallel sessions without collisions, and an after-merge wrap-up.

plugins.name: core-loop
plugins.description: Plan before code, three checks before done, a running log the agent can't skip.

plugins.name: decision-memory
plugins.description: Decisions made in chat become dated records; a drift check flags any live doc still using a retired name.

plugins.name: generated-views
plugins.description: Views built from source docs: no typed facts, a stale view fails a check.

plugins.name: parallel-sessions
plugins.description: Several agent sessions in one workspace: a desk per ticket (worktrees, ports, status), a log split one file per ticket, fast-forward-only landing.

plugins.name: after-merge
plugins.description: A background merge watch, a read-only smoke check, and /landed: production checks, one evidence note, a past-tense log entry.
